# Personas and roles

# Personas

## PER-HR-LEAD HR lead

```yaml
id: PER-HR-LEAD
title: HR lead
roles: [ROLE-HR-MANAGER]
```

Keeps employee records complete.

## PER-ACCOUNTANT Accountant

```yaml
id: PER-ACCOUNTANT
title: Accountant
roles: [ROLE-ACCOUNTANT]
```

Pays people correctly and on time.

## PER-EMPLOYEE Employee

```yaml
id: PER-EMPLOYEE
title: Employee
roles: [ROLE-EMPLOYEE]
```

Wants to see what they were paid.

# Roles

## ROLE-HR-MANAGER HR manager

```yaml
id: ROLE-HR-MANAGER
title: HR manager
```

## ROLE-ACCOUNTANT Accountant

```yaml
id: ROLE-ACCOUNTANT
title: Accountant
```

## ROLE-EMPLOYEE Employee

```yaml
id: ROLE-EMPLOYEE
title: Employee
```
